summary: The Trump administration is contesting judicial oversight of East Potomac Park renovation plans, with the Department of Justice seeking recusal of a judge overseeing the case. Separately, the White House is resisting requests for testimony and documents related to a Kennedy Center takeover, while families have protested the National Guard deployment at schools. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
